text:
sophie: Heads up — visiting researcher from U. of V is here early. They left a big terrarium (glass) and a bakery basket at the door. Front desk couldn't find their guest badge. :wave:
frontdesk: We received the terrarium and basket at 9:12am. No badge labeled. Left them on the low shelf by the lobby plants. There's a note: 'Dr. Gates — demo in Conf C by 10'.
mailroom-bot: Package delivered: 1x Glass terrarium (fragile), 1x Bakery basket. Delivered to FRONT_DESK at 09:12. Tracking: TRK12345
jamal: @frontdesk can you double-check the sign-in sheet? Maybe they checked in under 'Gates' or 'Gates, Dr.'
maria: I'll go down and grab the terrarium — careful with the glass! I'll bring an extra table.
alex: Also can someone save a slice of cake? :yum:
frontdesk: Checked sign-in: no match. There was a handwritten visitor form with mobile ending in 7722. Phone doesn't match any calendar invite.
sophie: Dr. Gates had an invite — I see them on the calendar under 'Research ops'. Maybe they used a personal email. @maria thanks — careful please.
lola: I can host them in the corner table in Conf C for setup. I'll bring a trolley for the terrarium.
jamal: If badge can't be located, can we issue a temporary badge? @frontdesk what's the usual process?
frontdesk: We can print a temp badge at reception. Need full name and org. We have 'Dr. Naomi Gates, Univ of V' on the sticky note.
mailroom-bot: Badge printer status: OK. Remaining temp badges: 12
sophie: Cool — please print 'Dr Naomi Gates — Univ of V' and wave them through. Tagging @jamal — can you escort them to Conf C at 9:40?
jamal: Yep, I'll meet at lobby in 5.
maria: Table arriving with terrarium. Please clear the north end of Conf C.
lola: Also owners of the bakery basket — can we add a label? Whoever claimed it can sign it out. :raised_hand:
alex: I claim the blueberry tart — I'll sign the paper.
sophie: Quick poll — who wants cake? Reply with :cake: to take a slice.
alex: :cake:
maria: :cake:
jamal: :green_heart:
frontdesk: Temp badge printed and on reception desk with 'Dr Naomi Gates'. Assigned badge ID: TEMP-087. Took a picture, DMing Sophie.
sophie: Perfect, thanks. Can someone help carry the terrarium into Conf C? It's heavy.
maria: On it — two people please.
lola: I'll help after I set up the trolley.
jamal: On my way. Be there in 2.
mailroom-bot: Reminder: oversized item TRK12345 to be logged in asset tracker. Please confirm transfer to conference room.
frontdesk: Confirmed transfer to Conf C at 09:30. Asset logged by frontdesk.
sophie: Thanks team — and thanks for the cake volunteers. :heart:
alex: Leaving a leftover slice in the kitchen with my name 'alex' on the Tupperware. First come, first serve.
jamal: :thumbsup:
frontdesk: All set. Closing thread.
